clips.title: The story
paras: Along Silverpine Forest's coast, shamans can renew their communion with water through Call of Water. Tiev Mordune offers another Water Sapta to those whose spirit-sight fades before they speak with the purified water spirit.

Shamans drink a Water Sapta to see spirits near the elemental shrines. If its magic fades before they speak with the Minor Manifestation of Water, they can no longer enter the spirit realm to finish the trial. On Silverpine Forest's fog-shrouded shore, fellow shaman Tiev Mordune helps those whose visions end too soon.

Tiev Mordune has already defeated the corrupt water spirit off the coast and waits with the ritual remnants he gathered. To show you are ready, bring a fresh Water Sapta from Islen Waterseer in the Barrens. Tiev casts his gathered bracers and droplets into the shrine's brazier, summoning the pure manifestation again so you can speak with it and seal your bond with the element.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Greetin's, friend! Have you too come to purify the waters here and prove your understandin' to Islen?
I've just defeated the corrupt water spirit meself, and I'm just 'bout to put da bracers and remaining drops o' water on the brazier.
What's dat? Ahhh. Tiev understan' all too well when somethin' goes wrong. Well, Tiev can help you plenty if you be needin' to see the pure water spirit again.
Bring me a water sapta from Islen as proof that you be ready, an' I'll wait to turn in me parts.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I know another that had trouble after defeating da corrupt water spirit--seems he waited too long and he came out of the spirit world too quick fer his taste. Hate to see dat happen to another, so I'll just wait here fer a bit to make sure no one else be needin' me help.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I'll put me items in the brazier den, and you c'n talk wit' da spirit too.
An' dontchu worry none 'bout seein' into da spirit world wit' da sapta... Ol' Tiev know a trick or two 'bout how da sapta magic works.
Come now, head down wit' me to the shrine and let's speak to da spirits together, friend.
